summary: Iteration 2 testing: Saturday blackout (backend + frontend warning), admin panel + Manage catalog nav, tours=5 count, typography/palette changes. All 11 backend tests pass and all 4 frontend flows verified. Previous iteration_1 tours=7 bug is FIXED (now 5 via delete_many $nin). No regressions on home page.

ui_bugs.issue: Continue-to-Payment button is NOT visually disabled when Saturday date is picked for taxi/rental. Submit is guarded (early return + toast.error) so users cannot actually submit, but the button should also be disabled or aria-disabled for clearer UX and better a11y.

issues: Two harmless /api/auth/me 401 console errors on every guest page load remain from iteration_1 — still not silenced.

Gold accent (#D4A94A) is used for hero italic word 'terms' and logo mark. Primary CTA buttons (Book a Taxi, Book Now) are still orange (#E86A3C) not gold — verify this is intentional; review request implied the palette swap replaced cyan with gold globally.

OPTIONAL: Silence /api/auth/me 401 console error for guest visitors (leftover from iteration_1).
